name: Trace how different work conventions shape a shared record

uses.action: Lift Derva’s slate and hear how the forge crew and the tally desk learned to read the same turned surface in their own work.

name: Distinguish what a speaker suggests from what a listener infers

uses.action: Read the carrier’s and keeper’s own accounts, check the hook from both approaches, and separate the missing direction from the carrier’s inference that the keeper meant to ignore them.

name: Interpret a specific religious object in its documented context

uses.action: Compare the figures visible on the exact Jain folio with the museum’s commissioning account. Keep sacred adornment, social context and the unknown individual motive distinct.

name: Keep counterexamples where a later case can use them

uses.action: Keep yesterday’s returned peg and the current request without a peg together in the checked loan warrant. Both cases can challenge a later rule based on visible marks alone.

name: Decide what another perspective can add to a particular claim

uses.action: Leave either a bounded direction or separately attributed accounts, then hear what Tirren could use about the route and what the accounts still leave open about intent.

name: Place a scope limit beside an actionable claim

uses.action: Revise the whole-lot notice for the two weighed lots. Keep their posted figures tied to their letters or leave a check for the next crate.
Post an order tied to the measured twelve incoming and two lost. Leave the affected crew’s work card with it and give a changed intake its own count.
